Independently substituted g(A,D) into Q to obtain F(D)=diag(D)+(Ds)^[2]=b+A^[2]b. The map is additive, not Fq-linear. Off-diagonal row sums cover exactly the sum-zero hyperplane.

Each zero fibre has (q/2)^(m-1)*q^(d-m+1)*2^m=2q^d points. Summed coordinates of F(D) are a+a², so its image is exactly the absolute-trace hyperplane. Every right side has sum zero, proving surjectivity onto J_m.

The literal E11 kernel element has Dickson invariant one and toggles every fibre, giving q^d in the specified Dickson kernel Omega. The proof of the J_m symplectic quotient counts every kernel parameter u,a explicitly.

Natural trace-block inverters have rank k and nonzero B(v,tv)=Tr(c0*bar(c)*v²). Thus the nonalternating class is proved without an algebraic-dimension inference. The full even-dimension-four bound is q9*nu2(SL2(q))=q11, including the identity image.
scope: Uniform natural orthogonal fixed-group kernel orders and bounds in characteristic two, with Omega explicitly the Dickson kernel. No triality, overgroup cover, generation conclusion or new original-table cell is asserted.
